dialogue_texts: 奇怪……剛才明明還看得到路。
That’s strange… I could see the path just a moment ago.
小水，你還記得我們是從哪邊進來的嗎？
Shui, do you remember which way we came in?
……兩條？|不對，剛剛這裡明明只有一條路。
…Two paths?|Wait. There was only one path here before.
連我自己都跑出來了……？
Now there’s another me…?
誰？|眼睛看見的，就一定是真的嗎？
Who’s there?|Can you trust everything you see?
如果連方向都分不清……又怎麼走得出迷霧森林？
If you can’t even tell which way to go… how will you ever escape the Misty Forest?
左邊的大樹、右邊的石頭……只要記清楚，就不會走錯。
Big tree on the left, rock on the right… If I remember them, I won’t get lost.
……怎麼又是這裡？|記得越清楚，就一定越接近答案嗎？
…How are we back here again?|Does remembering more always bring you closer to the answer?
到底哪一個才是真的……
Which one is real…?
連小水也……？
Even Shui…?
不對……這個也不像。|可是到底哪裡不一樣？
No… this one isn’t right either.|But what’s different about them?
等等……
Wait…
樹會變，路會變……連我的影子都會變。
The trees change. The paths change… Even my own shadow can change.
可是你一直都在。|這次，我相信你。|小水，帶我走。
But you’ve been right here all along.|This time, I trust you.|Shui, lead the way.
不是。|我只是知道，什麼才值得相信。|哦？不再相信自己的眼睛了嗎？
That’s not it.|I just know what’s worth trusting now.|Oh? You don’t trust your own eyes anymore?
很好。|看穿幻象，只是第一步。|接下來，讓我看看你的判斷……是不是也一樣可靠。
Very good.|Seeing through an illusion is only the first step.|Now let’s see whether your judgement is just as reliable.
成功了！
We did it!
真不錯！|你們通過我的考驗了。|看來這次，迷霧也騙不到你們了。
Very impressive!|You passed my trial.|Looks like the mist can’t fool you anymore.
太好了！|答應你們的。|前面的路，可以走囉！
Yes!|A promise is a promise.|The path ahead is open!
哇！霧真的散開了！|原來這裡這麼漂亮！
Wow! The mist really is clearing!|I never knew it was this beautiful!
咦？這裡有兩顆果實。|一顆黑色的……一顆白色的？|好奇怪喔。
Huh? There are two fruits here.|One black… and one white?|That’s strange.
你有聽到嗎？|前面好像有人。|走，小水。我們去看看！
Did you hear that?|I think someone’s up ahead.|Come on, Shui. Let’s go and see!
準備好了嗎？|迷霧會騙你的眼睛。|但答案，不會。
Ready?|The mist can fool your eyes.|But the answer won’t.
差一點……|小水，我們再多練習一下吧。
So close…|Shui, let’s practise a little more.
